subject: Pilot bundle pricing exception request — startup credits & early-access add-on
messages:
From: Ava Nguyen <ava@neuroai.co>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@neuroai.co>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot bundle pricing & credits — quick ask

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really helpful. We’re finalizing our accelerator acceptance package and I wanted to run one ask by you before we lock in the pilot. Two quick items: 

1) Startup credits — the program packet shows a standard $10k credit for accepted startups. Our accelerator requires a higher starter allowance for models that are multimodal (video + text) — would Redwood consider a one-time uplift to $25k for cohort members that meet the multimodal threshold? We’ve had trouble with vendors who won’t bend on bundled credit levels and that makes the curriculum less feasible.

2) Early-access add-on — we’d like to include an optional ‘early-access’ bundle (priority routing, 100k token burst, and an additional monitor slot) in the pilot offer. Can that be added to the pilot as a promotional exception (discounted or trial) so founders can evaluate latency and cost at scale?

We’re on a tight schedule — new cohort starts May 10. If doable, could you share a simple mutual action plan and any compliance checklist we need to surface to our cohort? I’ve attached a short pilot request doc with cohort details.

Best,
Ava
Founder, NeuroAI

Hi Ava — really appreciate the context and the doc. Congrats on the cohort acceptance. Quick answers up front and I’ll follow up with a proposed MAP: 

- Startup credit uplift: possible, but we typically require a short review to confirm the workload profile (token mix, average sequence length, and expected multimodal storage). If NeuroAI can share the prompt/asset distribution and a short estimate of monthly token volume, I can fast-track an exception for the cohort.

- Early-access add-on: we can include the add-on as a 30-day trial for up to 3 cohort teams or offer a 50% discounted first-month price — either works depending on your preference. The trial requires a minimal SLA carve-out and a signed pilot addendum (standard template).

Action items for you: share a one-page workload snapshot and confirm whether you want a trial or discounted month for the add-on. I’m looping in Ben (pricing) and Lauren (program partnerships) to confirm internal approvals and craft a concise mutual action plan.

I’ll aim to get a draft MAP and addendum by Monday EOD.

Cheers,
Rachel
Head of Startup GTM — Redwood Inference

Rachel / Lauren — quick internal note that I posted to the approvals queue. My read: we can carve the uplift to $25k for the cohort cohort-wide under a one-time promo (term sheet item), with two guardrails: 1) cohort must certify that participating teams meet the multimodal threshold (>=1TB assets/month or equivalent compute profile) and 2) we limit the uplift to the initial pilot month and require a usage report at month-end. 

For the early-access add-on, I prefer the 30-day trial (no charge) for up to 3 teams. If they exceed the trial burst quota we convert to the discounted rate (50%) for month 2 automatically unless they opt out. Operational notes: trial requires explicit SLA exception and a security handshake (we'll need SOC 2 artifact review for cohort leads).

If this matches product and partnerships' appetite, I’m okay moving to legal with a short one-page pilot addendum.

-ben

Hi Ava / Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround on the pilot doc. We reviewed internally and can support the requests with the following proposed terms: 

Summary of offer (pilot cohort package)
- Startup credits: one-time uplift to $25,000 per participating cohort team for teams that meet the multimodal threshold (definition below). Uplift applies to first 30 days of pilot usage only.
- Early-access add-on: 30-day trial (no charge) for up to 3 teams per cohort. Trial includes priority routing (up to 100k tokens burst) and one additional monitor slot. Excess burst usage converts to 50% discounted rate in month 2.

Multimodal threshold (for eligibility): either (A) average monthly asset ingestion >= 800GB OR (B) average combined token-equivalent compute >= 200M tokens/month. Your team’s one-page workload snapshot confirmed NeuroAI cohort members likely qualify under (A); thanks.

Operational requirements:
- Signed Pilot Addendum (attached draft) to capture the uplift and trial carve-outs.
- SOC 2 questionnaire or equivalent evidence from cohort leads (we can accept a pointer to their audit report).
- End-of-month usage report for the pilot period; Redwood reserves the right to convert uplifted credits to normal billing if usage profile materially differs from the certified snapshot.

Next steps / mutual action plan:
1) NeuroAI confirms the list of cohort teams eligible (names + contact emails) and confirms they accept the trial model.
2) NeuroAI signs the attached one-page Pilot Addendum (I attached a draft).
3) Redwood technical onboarding meeting for the 3 trial teams (we’ll schedule two 45-minute sessions the week of Apr 19).
4) End-of-month usage report + quick post-pilot QA call the week after the pilot ends.

I attached the one-page addendum and the pricing matrix we referenced. If this works, I’ll route the addendum to Legal for a short signature and confirm onboarding slots.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer to walk through the MAP.

Best,
Rachel
Head of Startup GTM — Redwood Inference
